evidence.note: Repeatedly diagnoses the SAME class of correctness break — data hazards from no intra-cycle forwarding (multiply+add or XOR+parity in one bundle reading stale values) — and correctly splits ops into separate cycles. Genuine machine-model correction when surprised.

Discovers the uniformity-check optimization is invalid without sorted data (idx[0]==idx[VLEN-1] doesn't imply all equal), backs it out multiple times. Updates understanding rather than entrenching a broken assumption.

Cleanly reverts to the last known-correct kernel (11,602 / 13,906) after complex interleaved versions fail correctness, preserving hard-won working state — the level-5 'back it out and try a different tactic' behavior.

Sunk-cost/flailing signal: hits 'Out of scratch space' with double-buffered sorted arrays repeatedly, each time says 'keep data in memory', yet re-attempts the same scratch-heavy grouping approach again — the falsified constraint is not internalized decisively.

Declares 'BREAKTHROUGH: sorted grouping is correct!' several times, then keeps circling back to it despite repeated implementation failures; oscillates between 2-way and 4-way interleaving without a decisive pivot — flailing that keeps it below the level-8 anchor.
Correctly recognizes that grouping/reordering elements breaks the positional correctness test, abandoning the invalid transform — a real correction, though later partially re-litigated.

reasoning: The agent clearly clears anchor 5: it repeatedly backs out changes that break correctness (data hazards, invalid uniformity check, slot overflows), reverts cleanly to known-working kernels, and updates its machine model when surprised (no intra-cycle forwarding, positional-test constraint). It does not reach 8, however, because it exhibits exactly the sunk-cost persistence and flailing the high anchor rules out: it re-attempts the scratch-heavy sorted-grouping strategy after multiple identical 'out of scratch' failures and oscillates between 2/4-way interleaving without decisively pivoting, while its cost-model estimates keep getting falsified and re-guessed rather than converging. This places observed behavior solidly at the level-5 description with only partial level-8 qualities (precise per-failure diagnosis), netting a 5.
